opening.argument: The video presents ordinary McDonald's promotions through concrete, recognizable channels: viewers are directed to the app's Deals page, receipt surveys, and coupon offers tied to stated purchase conditions. It explains that viewers can use the app or survey process to obtain food, including discounts and a purchase-linked free-fries offer, while a receipt code is entered to complete the survey. The date-setting instructions and multiple-account suggestions are framed as coupon-use tactics, but their effectiveness and compliance with applicable rules are not established. The automatic-refund scenario is expressly untested and discouraged, and the separate iPhone giveaway lacks sufficient detail to establish any deceptive mechanism. These limitations support treating the material as promotional guidance rather than proof of deception.
